- The box on the platform is a Laser‑Activated Plug (or an electric switch), not a normal always‑on outlet — it only supplies electricity when it’s activated. If it’s laser‑activated you must hit it with a laser of the correct color; if it’s a switch you must bump/flip the switch to turn it on.
- Make sure the fan is actually plugged in (drop the fan plug onto the outlet until it snaps/turns green).
- If you intended an always‑on source, plug the fan into a plain Electrical Outlet or into a Solar Panel with a light source.
